purpose: Make the architecture-neutral physical-cue material qualification rule executable and hash-addressed before confirmatory allocation.

hash_chain.promotion: Only a PASS receipt may be linked into the final confirmatory stimulus/schedule chain; changing the material specification requires a new pretest and receipt.

failure_policy: A failed material set is redesigned and re-tested architecture-neutrally. Do not exclude randomized confirmatory animals or alter cue identities after confirmatory allocation to rescue performance.
claim_ceiling: Passing qualifies simple cue learnability and gross salience balance only. It does not establish routeability, treatment effects, final N, ethics approval, or confirmatory biological performance.
